annotations.title: Count and summarise a search by group

description:
Counts and statistics over EXACTLY what `search_entities` would match: how many records, grouped by a field, with min, median, mean and max of up to three numeric fields. Use it for "how many", "what share", "median floor area" and "price by type" questions instead of paging through records.

    `query` is the same object `search_entities` takes (entity, geography, criteria). Summaries cover `properties`, `buildings`, `land` and `listings`. `group_by` is one choice field of that family and `measures` are its range fields; `entity_search_capabilities` lists them under `summary.families`. For example properties: group_by asset_subtype / asset_class / tenure / epc, measures bedrooms / floor_area; listings: group_by property_type / channel / auction / new_home, measures price / bedrooms / floor_area; buildings (a postcode district or a drawn area): group_by tenure / epc, measures footprint / storeys / units; land: group_by tenure, measures parcel_area / built_coverage.

    Example: {"query": {"entity": "listings", "geography": {"kind": "area", "id": "SW11"}, "criteria": {"transaction": ["sale"]}}, "group_by": "property_type", "measures": ["price"]}.

    A measure's `count` is the records that have a value for it; missing values are never zero. Groups come largest first, `top` of them (max 50), each with its `share` of the total. No record identities are returned: open records with `search_entities`. Too wide a place (a region) or too slow a summary is refused with what to narrow. Transaction counts by area: `market_volume_series`. Free.

SearchQuery.description: What to search: one family, where, and its refinements.

criteria.description: Refinements, an OBJECT keyed by refinement: a range is {"min": .., "max": ..} (inclusive, either bound optional), a choice is a list of allowed values, a date range is {"min": "YYYY-MM-DD", "max": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Keys and values per family come from `entity_search_capabilities`. e.g. {"parcel_area": {"min": 5000, "max": 9000}, "built_coverage": {"max": 10}}.
